categories.name: Control Flow and Functions
categories.description: Branching, loops, exit status, and reusable shell functions.

entries.title: if
entries.summary: Branch based on command success or test expressions.
entries.definition: Branch based on command success or test expressions.
entries.mental_model: In shell, conditions are commands whose exit status matters.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
if git diff --quiet; then
  echo clean
else
  echo dirty
fi
examples.explanation: Uses git exit status as a condition.

entries.title: case
entries.summary: Match a value against shell patterns.
entries.definition: Match a value against shell patterns.
entries.mental_model: Pattern-oriented multi-way branch.

examples.title: Example

entries.title: for
entries.summary: Iterate over a list of words/items.
entries.definition: Iterate over a list of words/items.
entries.mental_model: Each iteration assigns the next item to the loop variable.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
for key in M1 M2 M3; do
  echo "$key"
done

entries.title: while
entries.summary: Repeat while a command succeeds.
entries.definition: Repeat while a command succeeds.
entries.mental_model: The guard is reevaluated as a command/expression each iteration.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
n=0
while (( n < 3 )); do
  echo "$n"
  ((n++))
done

entries.title: Functions
entries.summary: Group shell commands under a reusable function name.
entries.definition: Group shell commands under a reusable function name.
entries.mental_model: A shell function executes in the current shell context unless explicitly isolated.

entries.title: Exit status
entries.summary: Use 0 for success and nonzero values for failure/conditions.
entries.definition: Use 0 for success and nonzero values for failure/conditions.
entries.mental_model: Exit codes are Bash's primary success/failure data channel.

examples.title: Example

entries.title: Pipelines

entries.definition: Connect stdout of one command to stdin of the next.
entries.mental_model: Commands become stages in a byte stream pipeline.

entries.title: Redirection
entries.summary: Send stdin/stdout/stderr to files or other descriptors.
entries.definition: Send stdin/stdout/stderr to files or other descriptors.
entries.mental_model: File descriptors are rewired before the command starts.

entries.definition: Run commands asynchronously in the shell with & and manage them with jobs/wait.
entries.mental_model: The shell launches the child without blocking immediately.

entries.title: getopts
entries.summary: Parse short command-line options in shell scripts.
entries.definition: Parse short command-line options in shell scripts.
entries.mental_model: Standard built-in parser for compact shell CLI flags.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
while getopts "n:" opt; do
  case "$opt" in n) name=$OPTARG ;; esac
done
